name: Quench Meet
description: Meet a hostile soul spark with its opposite and quench both before either can spread.

name: Spark Tell
description: Tell by the first glint of a hostile spark what kind of soul technique is about to follow.

name: Slaking Veil
description: Draw a damp veil over the soul that smothers the heat of a hostile soul strike.

name: Cooling Hand
description: Lay a cooling hand of stillness on an ally whose soul has been scorched until the scorching eases.

name: Choke Spark
description: Choke a foe's soul spark at its birth so that the technique behind it never lights.

name: Spark Cover
description: Throw a cover of cancelling force over an ally to quench a spark aimed at their soul.

name: Quenching Wave
description: Spread a wave of cancelling force over a group to quench a hostile soul wave aimed at them all.

name: Quench Release
description: Quench the lingering hold of a soul curse on an ally until the last thread of it lets go.

name: Opposed Pitch
description: Sound the pitch opposed to a hostile soul tone so that the two interfere and vanish.

name: Interference Read
description: Read the interference between two soul tones to learn which of them is the hostile one.

name: Counterweight
description: Hang a counterweight on the soul that balances a hostile pull before it can tip the mind.

name: Evening Tone
description: Even out the rises and falls of a strained ally's soul tone until it runs level and quiet.

name: Skewed Beat
description: Skew the beat of a foe's soul technique so that its parts no longer arrive together.

name: Opposed Wave
description: Send an opposed wave of frequency into a hostile soul surge until the two cancel to still air.

name: Interference Purge
description: Set up a clean interference inside an ally's soul that cancels the hum of a hostile taint.

name: Unmake Touch
description: Touch the heart of a hostile soul spell with its unmaking so that its shape slackens and falls.

name: Unspell Reading
description: Read the first binding thread of a soul spell to learn which pull will unmake it.

name: Unspool Guard
description: Let hostile soul force unspool harmlessly along the surface of the mind without catching.

name: Slack Mending
description: Slacken the cords of a tight soul spell on an ally and let the soul recover its ease.

name: Loose Thread
description: Find the loose thread in a foe's soul technique and pull it until the whole starts to fray.

name: Fade Order
description: Give the order to fade to a lingering hostile soul force and let it thin to nothing.

name: Unmaking Wave
description: Send a wave of unmaking through a hostile soul technique until its whole form comes undone.

name: Thread Release
description: Release the last binding threads of a soul spell from an ally one by one until they are free.

name: Unravel Hold
description: Hold a foe's soul technique at the point of unravelling so that it cannot form again for a moment.

name: Null Reading
description: Read the null point of an incoming soul technique in the instant before it arrives.

name: Null Meet
description: Meet a hostile soul force at its null point and let it cancel in the user's stillness.

name: Null Guard
description: Stand in the null point of a hostile soul force so that it passes through without effect.

name: Null Balm
description: Spread a null balm over an ally's soul so that the ache of a hostile mark fades.

name: Null Sweep
description: Sweep a field of stillness about the user that cancels all hostile soul force coming within it.

name: Null Clearing
description: Clear a hostile mark from an ally's soul by setting a patch of stillness against it.

name: Damped Meet
description: Meet a hostile soul note with a damped answer that eats its sound and leaves silence.

name: Damp Reading
description: Read how strongly a hostile soul force presses to learn how much damping it will need.

name: Muffle Guard
description: Wrap the soul in muffling layers so that a hostile note arrives faint and without bite.

name: Muffled Mending
description: Muffle the pain in the soul of an ally so that it can rest and begin to knit.

name: Smother Spark
description: Smother the first spark of a foe's soul technique under a blanket of cancelling force.

name: Hush Cover
description: Throw a hush over an ally so that a hostile soul note aimed at them is dampened to nothing.

name: Dulling Rap
description: Rap the edge of a foe's soul technique with a dulling pulse so that it lands without force.

name: Muffling Wave
description: Spread a wave of muffling force over a group to dampen every hostile soul note aimed at them.

name: Dampened Release
description: Dampen the grip of a soul curse on an ally until it relaxes and lets go.

name: Smothering Press
description: Press a smothering weight on a foe's soul technique until it cannot rise beyond a murmur.
